ExecutionPacketTemplate.write-scope: Exact file paths the worker may modify (its own module source; disjoint from other workers)
ExecutionPacketTemplate.contract-excerpt: The MODULE_CONTRACT (PURPOSE / SCOPE / DEPENDS / LINKS) copied from the shared artifacts, so the worker authors markup consistent with the graph without re-deriving boundaries.
ExecutionPacketTemplate.assumptions: Preconditions the worker may rely on (dependencies already documented, ID conventions, comment syntax for the file language)
ExecutionPacketTemplate.stop-conditions: When the worker must halt and report instead of proceeding (contract mismatch with code, unexpected public symbol, marker imbalance)
ExecutionPacketTemplate.retry-budget: How many self-correction passes before escalating to the controller
ExecutionPacketTemplate.expected-graph-delta-fields: Which knowledge-graph fields the controller expects to reconcile after the worker returns (annotations, depends, CrossLinks)
ExecutionPacketTemplate.expected-verification-delta-fields: Which verification-plan fields may change (test-files, module-checks, coverage-gap, required-log-markers)

GraphDeltaTemplate.removed-annotations: Public symbols that no longer exist
GraphDeltaTemplate.changed-crosslinks: CrossLinks added/removed to stay bidirectionally consistent

VerificationDeltaTemplate.changed-test-files: Test files added/removed for the module

FailurePacketTemplate.observed: What the code showed that did not match the packet
FailurePacketTemplate.needs-decision: The controller/user decision required to proceed

CheckpointReportTemplate.modules-done: Count and IDs of modules whose markup is complete
CheckpointReportTemplate.files-marked: Count of governed files that received markup
CheckpointReportTemplate.integrity: Result of the §9 checks (block pairing, graph<->code, verification coverage, CrossLink consistency)
